fields.value: Around 8+ years of IT experience designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-scale AI, cloud, and data engineering solutions on Microsoft Azure. Experienced in building enterprise Generative AI applications using OpenAI GPT-4, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures. Strong expertise in developing intelligent knowledge management and semantic search solutions using ChromaDB, Azure AI Search, embeddings, and vector search technologies. Proficient in prompt engineering, LLM orchestration, context management, transformer models, tokenization, and embedding techniques to improve AI application accuracy and performance. Hands-on experience evaluating and optimizing LLM applications using RAGAS, Cross-Encoder Re-ranking, Maximum Marginal Relevance (MMR), Semantic Caching, and retrieval optimization techniques. Experienced in developing scalable RESTful APIs and AI-powered microservices using Python, FastAPI, and cloud-native architectures for enterprise applications. Strong expertise in designing and implementing large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines using PySpark, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, and SSIS for processing structured and unstructured data. Proficient in working with SQL Server, Oracle, AWS Athena, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2) for enterprise data management, analytics, and reporting. Skilled in building cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, and related Azure services. Experienced in implementing CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices using Docker, Git, GitHub Actions, and GitLab CI/CD for automated deployment, testing, and version control. Proficient in developing interactive dashboards and analytical reports using Power BI and Azure Analysis Services (AAS) to support data-driven business decisions. Experienced working in Agile/Scrum environments, collaborating with cross-functional teams including business stakeholders, solution architects, data engineers, data scientists, DevOps engineers, and product owners to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performance enterprise AI and data solutions.
